name: What is the typical deposit structure for new development purchases in Miami-Dade County?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical deposit structure for new development purchases in Miami-Dade County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical deposit structure for new development purchases in Miami-Dade County often involves multiple payments. Developers usually require an initial deposit upon signing the reservation agreement, followed by additional deposits at specific construction milestones, such as groundbreaking, completion of the foundation, or reaching a certain floor. These deposits can range from 10% to 50% of the purchase price, spread out over the construction period. Understanding this staggered payment schedule is crucial for financial planning, and we can help clarify specific developer terms.
acceptedAnswer.description: New development deposits in Miami-Dade County typically involve multiple payments, often 10-50% of the purchase price, spread across construction milestones.
